name: coder-next-dind
postCreateCommand:
/bin/sh -lc 'for i in $(seq 1 120); do curl -sS -m 2 http://web:3000/api/db >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 2; done; if [ ! -f /tmp/web-proxy.pid ] || ! kill -0 $(cat /tmp/web-proxy.pid) 2>/dev/null; then nohup socat TCP-LISTEN:3000,fork,reuseaddr TCP:web:3000 >/tmp/web-proxy.log 2>&1 & echo $! >/tmp/web-proxy.pid; fi; printf "=== Workspace Self-test (status) ===
"; APP_URL=http://web:3000 npm run status:cli; printf "=== Workspace API Flow Test ===
"; APP_URL=http://web:3000 npm run test:cli; printf "=== Workspace Self-test (final) ===
"; APP_URL=http://web:3000 npm run status:cli'
postStartCommand:
/bin/sh -lc 'for i in $(seq 1 120); do curl -sS -m 2 http://web:3000/api/db >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 2; done; if [ ! -f /tmp/web-proxy.pid ] || ! kill -0 $(cat /tmp/web-proxy.pid) 2>/dev/null; then nohup socat TCP-LISTEN:3000,fork,reuseaddr TCP:web:3000 >/tmp/web-proxy.log 2>&1 & echo $! >/tmp/web-proxy.pid; fi; printf "=== Workspace Self-test (status) ===
"; APP_URL=http://web:3000 npm run status:cli; printf "=== Workspace API Flow Test ===
"; APP_URL=http://web:3000 npm run test:cli; printf "=== Workspace Self-test (final) ===
"; APP_URL=http://web:3000 npm run status:cli'
